lastFeedback: New dispatch. Your completed work, supplies and rare finds are saved.
scope: Batch Play Mode; production sandbox with camera-ray interactions and Unity physics fixtures. Tests every authored job, resource prerequisites, strict target compatibility, no ordinary rewards, one-time rare rewards, legacy persistence, physical driving, safe exits and transit. Original PlayerPrefs save is backed up and restored. Visual realism and full-scene traversal are separate checks.
checks: All 40 authored job definitions have valid targets, references and resource prerequisites.
The catalog contains 148 stages and 27 explicit device references.
The fixture makes all 40 job types actionable.
A new save starts without cash, XP or completed jobs.
Repair without a recovered component is refused.
Watering without carried water is refused.
Empty cargo cannot complete parcel or sample handoffs.
Empty recycling and empty field records cannot be submitted.
Wrong kinds and unknown actions have no permissive fallback.
Rejected operations leave dispatch and rewards unchanged.
A reassigned incompatible dispatch target cannot advance through E.
Destination panels keep their physical transit role.
A world without compatible job devices produces no wrong-kind fallback.
